name: Easy Note
description: A full-featured drawing canvas in the Obsidian sidebar. Currently supported on Windows and Android only. Supports Pixel mode (traditional paint layer) and Image mode (each stroke becomes a selectable layer), multi-color brushes, eraser, image layers with rubber-band multi-select, text layers, Markdown layers ([[wikilink]] and [text](url) links), named undo/redo history, and export to PNG / JPEG / WebP. Canvas state is saved as .enote. Touch and stylus supported.
author: welcsy
